relationships.subject: amitriptyline
relationships.evidence_quote: Whole-cell patch-clamp recordings on cultured sensory neurons revealed that amitriptyline was a potent inhibitor of the main voltage-gated sodium channels (Nav1.7, Nav1.8, and Nav1.9) found in nociceptors.

relationships.subject: amitriptyline
relationships.evidence_quote: Calcium imaging showed that amitriptyline activated the transient receptor potential cation channel, TRPA1.

key_findings: Topical 10% amitriptyline was associated with pain relief in CIPN patients without systemic adverse events.
In mice it inhibits nociceptor Nav1.7/1.8/1.9 and activates TRPA1.
